summary: AMTD Digital (NYSE: HKD) disclosed a Form 6-K reporting its November 2, 2026 transfer of four premium hotel assets into its controlled subsidiary The Generation Essentials Group (NYSE/LSE: TGE) under an Asset Transfer and Share Issuance Agreement dated October 21, 2026. TGE issued 198,630,381 new Class A ordinary shares to AMTD Digital as full consideration for an aggregate US$209,766,000 purchase price, including underlying debt. Pricing used TGE's 30-day VWAP for the thirty trading days ending May 29, 2026. Post-closing, AMTD Digital holds 88.2% of TGE shares and 91.1% of voting power; AMTD IDEA Group beneficially owns 95.6%. Watch related-party valuation, minority overhang, and TGE integration risk.
